questions.stem: SYNTHETIC. What is the derivative of x^2?
questions.explanation: Power rule: d/dx x^n = n x^(n-1).

questions.stem: SYNTHETIC. Which function solves y' = y?
questions.explanation: The exponential is its own derivative.

questions.stem: SYNTHETIC. What is the integral of 1/x for x > 0?
questions.answer_note: AI NOTE: Source marked D; correct is C because d/dx ln x = 1/x.

questions.stem: SYNTHETIC. What is the order of y'' + y = 0?
questions.explanation: AI NOTE (explanation corrected): the highest derivative present is y'', so the order is 2.
